snippet.title: Butcher of the North | Gameplay Trailer 4K
snippet.description:
The New Year is coming, which means it's time to release a New Year's horror game!

Butcher of the North is a first-person horror game. You never received any Christmas presents. This year, you decided to take them yourself. After determining Santa's IP address, you head to his lair to take what is rightfully yours. But you weren't prepared for what awaited you there.

Gameplay
Stop waiting for gifts. It's time to take them. Take everything you can carry.
Explore a creepy lair filled with deadly secrets.
Face terrifying creatures serving Santa.
Uncover the main secret of the New Year's workshop.

#horrorgame #gametrailers #newgame
